card.name: Dosing-table words before cross-references
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside dosing instructions: a digit in a number, a space before a number, or a linking word or comma ahead of a cross-reference or condition. It appears in dose tables, infusion preparation and dose-modification text.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: The digit or space just before a value in a dose table, concentration or temperature range.
modes.example: and <15,000 ng/mL 48 hours 24 hours 1.5 mg vial ≥15,0<<0>>0 ng/mL and <60,

modes.label: Linking words before references
modes.description: A word or comma that leads into a pointer to other instructions or to the next condition.
modes.example: For additional information on preparation, administration, and storage see<< the>> full prescribing information. ( 2.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words like manual and applicable, as in a pointer to a reference document.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting bits in dosing text, such as digits, spaces and "see the", where the label points to other instructions.
